what: Service back up, B still closed: A (on the title after a stray Escape) Continue → door → People → Bea → Remove → Remove them (a member.remove); run-19's door actions

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world; if (s.screen === 'play' && w.status === 'ready' && w.value.status.link === 'online') break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value; return JSON.stringify({ head: w.now.head.n, link: w.status.link }) })()
(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); if (!l) return 'no door'; const t = l.innerText; const i = t.indexOf('People'); return t.slice(i, i + 500) })()

(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const row = [...l.querySelectorAll('div')].filter(d => d.innerText.startsWith('Bea') && [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Remove')).sort((a, b) => a.innerText.length - b.innerText.length)[0]; if (!row) return 'no row'; [...row.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Remove').click(); return 'clicked Remove on ' + row.innerText.slice(0, 60) })()

(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const b = [...l.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => /^(Remove Bea|Yes, remove|Confirm|Remove them)/.test(x.innerText.trim())); if (b) { b.click(); return 'confirmed: ' + b.innerText.trim(); } return 'no confirm step' })()

(async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value; if (w.status.pending === 0 && Object.values(w.now.events).some(e => e.kind === 'member.remove')) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value; const rm = Object.values(w.now.events).find(e => e.kind === 'member.remove'); return JSON.stringify({ head: w.now.head.n, remove: rm ? { n: rm.n, id: rm.id.slice(0, 12) } : null }) })()
